title: random whimscial hobbies to try out!
excerpt: hiiii guys, and here are some random fun hobbies that i think can add whimsy to your life! now i personally don’t do all of these, (who has the time 😭😭), but…

blocks.value: hiiii guys, and here are some random fun hobbies that i think can add whimsy to your life! now i personally don’t do all of these, (who has the time 😭😭), but i do think they are so cute and fun and whimsical! ✨so here we go!!

ok i’m really not putting a lot about this one, because i hope you guys can already see the irony. i have just started to blogging, and i actually love it so much so far. i know i don’t have all that much experience, this being my 4th blog post, but this website has actually taken months to make, and the process was so fun, whether it was choosing the design or even learning some code!

I know that many people can’t take the time to set up a whole blog, but there are plenty of teen blog sites or you can make a website through google sites as well! whether you write about your daily life, or things you like, or more, blogging is a fun and really interesting hobby!

omg this is one of my favorite hobbies ever! i don’t do it very often, because i actually don’t have a lot of supplies for it at all. 😅😅 but this hobby is amazingly fun because it almost always turns out beautiful! And it really just brings so much joy in my life when i get to peel off stickers. it’s so beautifully satisfying!

i deeply recommend this hobby to everybody, and you can use literally anything, like random magazine scraps, old stickers, etc etc… that’s about all i have to say. i just realize how ironic it is that i put that blogging was going to be short at the beginning but it ended up being the longer one. well, thats ok.

yes, i know this isn’t much of a hobby, but i love drawing or doodling random things in my spare time, even if they look horrendous. it just gives me some nice relaxation, if you know what i mean by that. and actually, i always thought that i was a terrible artist, but i’ve been slowly growing. I started trying to understand proportions more, and gotten better.

to be honest, it’s not that hard to grow at drawing, the only thing is you just need to keep doing it. I used to suck at faces, but i’m slowly improving day by day. every class i doodle faces in my notebooks and it is really the reason i have gotten better. (not trying to tell you to not pay attention in class). It doesn’t even have to be detailed, but practicing doodling will really help you, so try it out. :)

this another one of those hobbies that i have tried and unfortunately never finished learning. In fact i was crocheting right now. All i can do is make a slip knot and do the chain thingys. I keep forgettign how to turn around and start to single crochet. But everytime I try learning it it is really fun for me, so i do dearly recommend trying to crochet.

My friend is the one who usually tries to teach me how to crochet, because she’s an expert. She makes these intricate stuffed animals and blanketsa and scarves and bags. That’s definietly a plus to crocheting, you can make a bunch of things yourself! And crocheting isn’t it. Also knitting and sewing and other such hobbies are great to try!

finally another hobby I do. well, i try too. I am very bad at cooking, I have successfully tried to cook exactly one meal. mango sticky rice. and that was a fluke. i’m too scared to try to make it again in case i fail miserably. other than that, i have also tried but failed at making 3 different kinds of pasta, pudding, pancakes, eggs, rice, and even box mac-and-cheese.

but it’s fun. it’s really fun. and thats why i keep doing it. i feel happy laying out the ingredients and mixing them together and hoping dearly that it will taste good. it is a very enjoyable hobby and I do in fact recommend it to people. it’s very fun activity even if you aren’t the best at it.
that’s it for this one! i’m definitely making a part 2, 3 4, and maybe 5! this was really fun. anyways, I hope you enjoyed my offical 4th blog post ever!
